intro.description: The mysterious Moonstone is one of the most sought-after semi-precious gemstones in the world, and it is easy to see why: the Moonstone meaning is extensive and varied. The beautiful Moonstone is a stone of emotional balance, and as an aid to diving deep into one's own self to find the inner truth, inner wisdom, and connect to the higher self. It is connected to the energies of the Moon, which makes it associated with the Moon.

tabs.tab1_description:
Moonstone gemstone invites us to dance in sensual joy and to feel at ease while investigating the world's many mysteries. In tantric and other sensual rituals, it can be used to sanctify the ceremonies of love and delight. It activates our most potent psychic abilities, arousing and fortifying our intuition and fostering all facets of empowered femininity.

Moonstone eliminates the slanderous stereotypes and labels that have plagued women for centuries. It highlights their true beauty, bestowing upon them pride, happiness, and comprehension. As a stone of new beginnings, it casts a dazzling and benevolent light on all of our aspirations and assists us in charting a path forward. It offers protection and good fortune to travelers and those embarking on a new journey. It invites us to recognize the deity in all of her many guises and eras, and to recognize the deity in every woman.

Moonstones have been a tangible connection to the moon's magic since ancient times. It is a protective amulet for travelers, a gift from ardent lovers, a conduit for prophecy, and a path to enlightenment. Our connections to the moon are robust. As it grows and declines in cyclic perfection, it develops the tides and patterns of our mother, the Earth, and affects our behaviors, emotions and spiritual development. The white moonstone is both calming and energizing, illuminating the natural rhythms of life.

Moonstone comprises a group of iridescent Feldspar minerals. Typically, they are white stones with a silvery-white, blue, or complete prismatic rainbow on the surface. In addition to black and orange, they can also be silvery-white and black. Sunstones are composed of the same minerals as moonstones, with the exception that they are orange stones with a golden or orange iridescence.

In Vedic astrology, Moonstone is ruled by the planet Moon. All your basic habits, behaviors, personal needs and emotions are governed by the Moon. It influences your overall personality in terms of physical growth. A strong Moon in your birth chart means stronger creativity, imagination, fearlessness, emotional balance, adaptability and introspection. The malefic effects of the Moon include emotional instability, fears, insecurity, restlessness, moodiness and irrationality. If you want to attract the positive powers of the Moon, you may wear a Moonstone.

One of the best ways to make your dreams come true is to time your manifestation process with the moon. At different points in the moon's natural cycle, you can set new goals or make sure that the ones you already have are strong. Moonstone is a powerful tool for making things happen because it uses the power of the moon, especially the power of the full moon.

The moonstone meaning encompasses the mental state, thoughts and mental well-being. The extremely comforting motherly energies of the Moonstone gemstone covers the wearer with a cocoon of warmth and love.

This jewel is highly recommended for travelers. If a traveler carries a talisman crafted from white moonstone, his journey will be protected by the stone's mystical properties. You will be able to discern whether a known travel companion intends to harm you.

It is connected with the night and the moon and fosters emotional depth, so its use can awaken intuitive abilities.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Moonstone gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Moonstone. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Sacral Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Natural Moonstone is ideal to be worn by those suffering from sleep disorders or those who are not able to sleep soundly should wear Moonstone rock. Men wear Moonstone by wearing Moonstone for men jewelry, to explore the nurturing Yin/feminine side thereby bringing balance. Moonstone gem promotes love so anyone wanting to increase the love quotient in a relationship can wear Moon Stone Jewelry.

Moonstone is best worn in the case of mental trauma, depression, and emotional turmoil. If you are suffering from sleeplessness, you can certainly wear a Moonstone. Those born in the moonstone month of June can wear it too. If conception is a problem for a woman, then wearing this stone would give her positive results.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Moonstone gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Moonstone gemstones.

Moonstone Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

The majority of Moonstones on the market originate in India, Madagascar, or Sri Lanka. The United States, Australia, Austria, Mexico, and Switzerland also contain notable deposits.

Observe their Color:

People have always agreed on the characteristics that the most coveted moonstones should possess: a colorless, semi transparent almost transparent look without visible inclusions and a brilliant blue adularescence, also known as blue sheen in the trade.

The finest moonstone transparent, electric blue shimmer.

Notice their Clarity:

A good quality Moonstone has a shiny, smooth, spotless surface.

Examine their Inclusions:

A quality moonstone should be nearly transparent and free of inclusions to the greatest extent possible. Inclusions have the potential to impede adularescence.

See their Shape:

It is typically polished into various shapes, including oval, round, cushion, pear, and square. This translucent gemstone is best suited for the cabochon cut, made from the big clusters of natural Moonstone.

Check the Carats:

For Moonstone of gem quality, the raw Moonstone is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Moonstone weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Moonstone is sold by weight, Moonstone prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Moonstone has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Moonstone

Due to treatments the Moonstone stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Moonstone do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Moonstone gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Moonstone are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Moonstone from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Moonstone gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

How to Energize & Recharge Moonstone Gemstone?

Hold the Moonstone in your hand and Chant the Moonstone gemstone Mantra:

Om Chandraya Namah || ॐ चन्द्राय नम || 108 times.

While chanting the mantra you can visualize white color positive energy surrounding your Moonstone and restoring its powers.

Other Mantras of Lord Chandra (Moon) you can chant are mentioned below

Vedic Stotra Mantra for Chandra Planet

Chandradev is of white color, wears white clothes, and is adorned with ornaments of white color. May the moon god instill confidence in me and illuminate my life.

How to check if Moonstone suits you?

Preferably, a powerful gemstone such as Moonstone should only be worn after consultation with an RRCT specialist. Nevertheless, it will be appropriate if worn according to RRCT, and we will add bhasm and energize it for only positive effects.

You can also give yourself at least 72 hours after embracing a Moonstone to determine whether or not you are experiencing any negative effects. If after 72 hours of embracing the Moonstone stone you do not feel even the slightest effect, you are safe to use Moonstone, as this shows it is safe and sure for you and it will not negatively affect you in any way.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Moonstone is a good choice for you. You will soon receive a subtle indication that wealth and good fortune are abundant in your life. Moonstone has been considered a gemstone of luck and prosperity for centuries.

How to know if Moonstone is working?

Within 10 days of wearing, you should start feeling calmer in your attitude to life. Moonstone fosters us to connect with one another heart-to-heart and to communicate openly about our mental, physical, and spiritual desires. It assists us in sorting through our emotions and gaining a deeper understanding of both the surface and underlying currents. It calms overreactions and allows us to explore our impulses and patterns in a safe environment. It encourages us to let go of negative energies that serve no purpose and to remain open to blessings and goodness at all times. If you feel these emotions upsurging in you then it means your moonstone gemstone is working for you.

How long do the effects of Moonstone last?

If cared for properly, a Moonstone can be worn as jewelry for generations. You must wear it until your chakras are balanced. Typically, experts advise wearing gemstones for four years, after which they are no longer necessary.
tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Moonstone gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Moonstone is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

Moonstones have mostly been accepted with a colorless, semi transparent to nearly transparent blue. The best quality Moonstone is watery blue or white.

Cut

Best quality Moonstone stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area. The commonest shape of a Moonstone is Cabochon, i.e. the flat reverse with an obverse convex. However, faceted moonstones are also popular these days.

Carat

Moonstone of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Moonstone are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Moonstone rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Best quality Moonstone has a smooth, spotless surface. However, most of the stones do contain some inclusions, and they are readily accepted. It is recommended that you buy a Moonstone of minimum or no inclusions inside or on the surface.

Traders deal in Moonstone that is synthetic to natural but is treated/heated and color enhanced, so you must buy only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputable lab.

Moonstone gemstone Price

Moonstone price depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. This is a very useful gemstone for those who have issues stemming from an imbalance in their sacral chakra, despite its low price. Make sure to purchase a moonstone gemstone that has not been heated or treated in any way.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Moonstone has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Moonstone stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Moonstone gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 550 to INR 2,185 (USD 6 to USD 27).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Moonstone?

The best way to check the authenticity of Moonstone is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Moonstone are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Moonstone carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Moonstone is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Moonstone have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Moonstone, but if you find flaws, then your Moonstone is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Moonstone are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Moonstone. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Moonstone, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Moonstone from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Moonstone. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Moonstone. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Moonstone Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Warm soapy water is the best suitable substance for cleaning moonstone.

Moonstone can be shattered by extreme heat or abrupt temperature changes. It is resistant to light but corroded by hydrofluoric acid.

Avoid the use of ultrasonic and steam cleaners.
